deviations: Country-level Stata xtreg, fe with i.YEAR_DATA translated to fixest::feols with panel and year fixed effects; Stata L. lags built by matching YEAR_DATA-1 within the xtset panel (COUNTRY_ID for Table A1, leader_cab_id for Table A2) on the full dataset before applying the democracy1==0 & independent==1 filter. fixest drops fixed-effect singletons (no effect on coefficients) and uses its own small-sample clustered SE correction, which differs slightly from Stata's xtreg.

Individual-level lfe::felm models translated to fixest::feols; the failed coup factor coupattempt_presentyear is coded as a 0/1 indicator (1 = 'Coup attempt'), equivalent to the factor dummy felm creates.
notes: Attempt-1 was exploratory (variable inspection, no RESULT lines). Attempt-2 printed NA for the four country-level claims because update() on a formula containing '|' merged regressors and fixed effects into one term; fixed by writing the formulas out. No comparison with claimed values was used to change the script. Individual-level Ns match the authors' appendix_k1/k2.tex (90020, 86057, 76530, 90014).
